import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Published biochemical data for SERPINA6 (CBG) deficiency.
# Sources:
#  Torpy et al. 2001 JCEM (PMID 11502797) -- c.121G>A null kindred
#  Emptoz-Bonneton et al. 2000 JCEM (PMID 10634411) -- CBG Lyon (D367N) proband
#  Gagliardi, Ho & Torpy 2010 (PMID 19643166) -- affinity reductions
#  Hill et al. 2012 JCEM (PMID 22948765) -- CBG Athens (W371S) / D367N
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12.5, 8.5))

# Panel A: plasma immunoreactive CBG by genotype (Torpy 2001 null kindred)
ax = axes[0, 0]
labels = ["Reference\nrange", "Null\nheterozygote", "Null\nhomozygote"]
vals   = [41.0, 18.7, 0.0]          # ug/mL; reference midpoint of 30-52
errs   = [11.0, 1.3, 0.0]           # half-width of reference range; SEM for het
cols   = ["#4C72B0", "#DD8452", "#C44E52"]
ax.bar(labels, vals, yerr=errs, capsize=5, color=cols, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6)
ax.axhspan(30, 52, color="#4C72B0", alpha=0.12, zorder=0)
ax.set_ylabel("Plasma immunoreactive CBG (ug/mL)")
ax.set_title("A. CBG protein falls with null allele dose\n(c.121G>A kindred, PMID 11502797)", fontsize=10)
ax.text(2, 1.5, "undetectable", ha="center", fontsize=8, style="italic")
for i, v in enumerate(vals):
    if v > 0:
        ax.text(i, v + errs[i] + 1.2, f"{v:.1f}", ha="center", fontsize=9)

# Panel B: CBG Lyon proband vs reference women (Emptoz-Bonneton 2000)
ax = axes[0, 1]
metrics = ["Serum CBG\n(mg/L)", "Cortisol Ka\n(L/nmol x 10)", "Free cortisol\n(% of total)"]
ref     = [44.0, 8.2, 3.4]
ref_err = [6.0, 2.9, 0.5]
pat     = [24.0, 1.2, 9.2]
x = np.arange(len(metrics)); w = 0.36
ax.bar(x - w/2, ref, w, yerr=ref_err, capsize=4, label="Reference women",
       color="#4C72B0", edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6)
ax.bar(x + w/2, pat, w, label="CBG Lyon proband",
       color="#C44E52", edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(metrics, fontsize=9)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_ylabel("Value (units as labelled)")
ax.set_title("B. CBG Lyon (p.Asp367Asn): low CBG, 7-fold lower affinity,\n"
             "free cortisol fraction raised ~2.7x (PMID 10634411)", fontsize=10)

# Panel C: total vs free cortisol compensation
ax = axes[1, 0]
# total morning cortisol: reference 204-546 nmol/L, proband 22-61 nmol/L
tot_ref = (204 + 546) / 2; tot_pat = (22 + 61) / 2
free_ref = tot_ref * 0.034
free_pat = tot_pat * 0.092
groups = ["Reference", "CBG Lyon\nproband"]
tot = [tot_ref, tot_pat]; free = [free_ref, free_pat]
x = np.arange(2); w = 0.36
ax.bar(x - w/2, tot, w, label="Total cortisol", color="#8172B3", edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6)
ax.bar(x + w/2, free, w, label="Free (unbound) cortisol", color="#CCB974", edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6)
for i in range(2):
    ax.text(i - w/2, tot[i] + 8, f"{tot[i]:.0f}", ha="center", fontsize=9)
    ax.text(i + w/2, free[i] + 8, f"{free[i]:.1f}", ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(groups)
ax.set_ylabel("Cortisol (nmol/L)")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("C. Total cortisol collapses 90% while free cortisol is\n"
             "near-preserved: the core diagnostic trap", fontsize=10)
print(f"Total cortisol ratio patient/reference : {tot_pat/tot_ref:.3f}")
print(f"Free  cortisol ratio patient/reference : {free_pat/free_ref:.3f}")

# Panel D: variant catalogue, mechanism class
ax = axes[1, 1]
variants = ["c.121G>A\n(null, exon 2)", "D367N\n(Lyon)", "W371S\n(Athens)",
            "L93H\n(Leuven)", "A224S", "G335V", "T342A"]
# fraction of wild-type cortisol-binding activity (approximate, from cited functional work)
activity = [0.00, 0.00, 0.00, 0.33, 1.00, 0.85, 1.00]
mech     = ["quantity", "quality", "quality", "quality", "neutral", "quality", "quality"]
cmap = {"quantity": "#C44E52", "quality": "#DD8452", "neutral": "#55A868"}
ax.barh(variants, activity, color=[cmap[m] for m in mech], edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6)
ax.set_xlabel("Residual cortisol-binding activity (fraction of wild type)")
ax.set_xlim(0, 1.15)
handles = [plt.Rectangle((0, 0), 1, 1, color=cmap[k]) for k in ["quantity", "quality", "neutral"]]
ax.legend(handles, ["Reduced CBG quantity", "Reduced CBG quality/affinity", "No functional effect"],
          fontsize=8, loc="lower right")
ax.set_title("D. SERPINA6 variants split into quantity and quality defects\n"
             "(PMIDs 11502797, 10634411, 22948765, 20226861)", fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
